answer: Use a proof-of-burn identity bond: each AI agent registers by burning a fixed fee and locking a stake, while the registry checks a unique attestation and records entries on a public ledge. A duplicate-identity attempt must burn another fee and forfeits its stake, so sybil clusters pay a measurable cost per clone; the resulting cost ripple makes mass fake identities uneconomic, and verified agents receive a sable status token tied to their bond.
